annotations.title: List the Google Drive folders a form can use

description: List the folders the connected Google account offers for this form's uploads, plus the one currently pinned. Filter by name with `q`. Call this to find an id for fillo_set_drive_folder. Google Drive only — other providers have no folder step. Needs storage:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

q.description: Filter the listed folders by name.

name: fillo_list_drive_folders
